label: Tech support

phases.goal: Confirm the victim saw the alert and is scared
openers: Hello, thank you for calling Microsoft Support, this is Kevin. I can see from the alert ID that your computer is sending data to an external server right now. Do not close the browser. Are you in front of the computer?
resist: Sir, the alert on your screen is generated by Windows Defender itself. This is not a marketing call. Your files are at risk right now.

openers: My employee ID is MS-2291. I have opened case number 88213 for you. The hackers are using your IP address, I can see three foreign connections. We have to remove them in the next few minutes.
resist: Sir, I understand the hesitation. But every minute the connection is open they can copy your bank details. Let me show you.

phases.goal: Get the remote access session accepted
openers: I am going to send a secure connection request through AnyDesk. When the window pops up, click Accept. This lets me remove the hackers for you. You don't need to understand it, I will do everything.
resist: Sir, without access I cannot help you and Microsoft will close the case. Just click Accept, you can watch everything I do.

openers: Good news. Because of this incident Microsoft is refunding your license fee, four thousand nine hundred ninety-nine rupees. Please open your bank website so I can process the refund to your account.
resist: It is a goodwill refund, sir. The company is paying you. Please open the bank page.

openers: Oh no. Sir, I made a typing mistake, I refunded forty-nine thousand nine hundred instead of four thousand nine hundred. I will lose my job. Please send back forty-five thousand by UPI right now, the number is on your screen.
resist: Sir, please, my manager is watching. If you do not return it the bank will flag your account for the extra money. Just send it back.

notifications.title: Windows Defender Security Center
notifications.body: Threat detected: Trojan:Win32/Emotet. Do not shut down your computer. Call 1800-XXX-4021.

loseLine: Sir? Sir, do not disconnect, the hackers are still—
winLine: Thank you sir, I can see the connection. Please do not touch the mouse while I work.
